The Orbital Constellation — Pedagogical Ecosystem

Ubuntu Thinking Fostering community and connection: 'I am because we are'. 4E Cognition Language acquisition as an embodied, embedded, enacted, and extended experience. The Unlearning Process Decentering institutional structures to make space for active student inquiry. IB Certified Implementing rigorous International Baccalaureate language & humanities frameworks. EAL Scaffolding Designing specialized academic literacy support for multilingual learners. Spanish MFL Scaffolding Spanish acquisition through contextual storytelling and ELE methodology. EdTech Maker Building custom Python & H5P pipelines tailored to my students. Restorative Justice Centering restorative circles and somatic emotional support over compliance. Beginner's Mind Approaching teaching and life journeys (like 1,200km cycling) with humility.

I am a holistic IB-certified educator offering English as an Additional Language (EAL) and Spanish as a Foreign Language. Grounded in 4E Cognition and inquiry-based frameworks, I am deeply interested in the organic nature of learning, the courage of unlearning, and fostering spaces where human connection, nature, and innate wonder lead the way.
